label: PF Backlog 236
title: Capability fallback + escalate-on-failure routing
body: In the Model-Gate/router: if the assigned model lacks a needed capability, auto-substitute a fitting candidate; on repeated failure (compliance/quality) escalate to a stronger tier. Otherwise surface a recommendation. Config-driven, observable.
_note: core/escalation.py ladder (from model-tier profiles) + agent_escalation event on failed gate. Remaining: auto-route the retry to the stronger tier (escalate-on-failure execution).
